title: Zesty Crispy Japanese Grape Tomatoes Inari Zushi
description: A winey and crispy Japanese dish from the Tohoku region featuring grape tomatoes and coconut cream, served in a Buddhist temple friendly form of inarizushi.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together coconut cream, rice vinegar, sugar, and salt.
Add the halved grape tomatoes to the bowl and toss to coat with the coconut cream mixture.
Arrange the grape tomatoes on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the sesame oil over the grape tomatoes and sprinkle with crushed sesame seeds.
Bake the grape tomatoes in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until crispy.
While the grape tomatoes are baking, cook the inari pouches according to the package instructions.
To assemble the inarizushi, fill each inari pouch with a few crispy grape tomatoes and a sprinkle of chopped cilantro.
Serve the zesty crispy Japanese grape tomatoes inarizushi immediately.
